annotations.text:
The Showdown table, large print. Four competitors around a round table, jumbo-index cards, nothing under 14px, and the move pinned to a bar that never scrolls away.

Competitor card rank: 20px (was 5px).
Today's build, for comparison. Five competitors in a grid; seat name 11px, badge 9px, card rank 5px.
The alternative we did not take: a full-width row per competitor. Rank reaches 30px, but the round table goes away and the scroll gets long.
